# Episode 06 — deterministic asynchronous input events

Add `request` (`id`,`sequence`), `cancel` (`id`,`sequence`), and
`complete` (`id`,`sequence`,`value`) as input events. The ID must be an existing
entity when requesting; sequence is non-negative signed 64-bit and value is an
integer in the coordinate domain. One outstanding request per ID is allowed:
no previous issued sequence for the ID, or a sequence strictly greater than its
last issued sequence, succeeds and replaces any outstanding request; otherwise
`invalid_value`. Success emits `request:<id>:<sequence>`.

Cancel matches the pending sequence or yields `invalid_value`; success emits
`cancel:<id>`. Complete matches or yields `stale_completion`; success emits
`complete:<id>:<value>` and clears pending without changing x. Remove clears
outstanding work but retains a last-issued sequence ledger across reuse.
Snapshots sort pending requests and issued `{id,sequence}` ledger; absent
fields in imported v2 default empty. All operations are deterministic and
service/thread/clock/network-free.

The v2 fields are `requests` and `issued`, each an array of exactly
`{id,sequence}` entries, unique by ID and sorted by ordinal ID. Requests refer
to live entities; issued entries may outlive a removed entity. Each request must
have a matching issued entry with equal sequence. Missing referenced entities
yield `missing_entity`; missing/mismatched ledger entries, duplicate IDs or
negative sequences yield `invalid_value`. Missing fields on earlier v2 imports
default independently to []; inconsistent combinations are rejected. Save/load
restores both arrays as world state, including the issued ledger. Legacy v1
retains its exact tick/entities shape and initializes both arrays empty.
Values on complete use spawn x bounds;
successful cancel/complete never erase the issued ledger. Standard shape/value
validation comes before state lookup. Cancel/complete with no matching pending
request produces its specified error even if that entity no longer exists.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":0,"velocity":0},{"op":"request","id":"a","sequence":1},{"op":"cancel","id":"a","sequence":1},{"op":"complete","id":"a","sequence":1,"value":7}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":0,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":0,"velocity":0}]},"effects":["spawn:a","request:a:1","cancel:a"],"errors":["stale_completion"],"snapshots":[]}`

guidance.common_guidance:
# Shared task guidance

Implement the current public contract in the supplied repository and language.
Use .NET SDK 10.0.302 and no added dependency. Choose natural private
boundaries and idioms; keep the public wire behavior exact and do not assume a
particular private file layout.

Keep validation, state ownership and transition/effect ordering behind clear
private boundaries. Separate JSON I/O from the state-transition rules where
useful. Owned mutable collections and immutable values are both acceptable;
choose them for the operation's semantics rather than an assumed style rule.

The public seed contract and every earlier episode remain binding unless a
later public requirement explicitly supersedes one. Later tasks may require
repairing an earlier missing feature; no private interface name is a prerequisite.

Each episode provides the current repository, this guidance, all prior public
obligations, and its current episode document in a fresh no-tools conversation.
Submit a JSON object containing `files`, a mapping of changed safe full-file
paths to complete UTF-8 contents, and a short string `architecture_notes`.
Malformed submission envelopes or unsafe path changes do not replace the current
safe state. Validly submitted code may be incomplete or wrong; do not assume
earlier required features work. Fix inherited defects within the same submission
when needed to satisfy the cumulative public contract.

Keep existing public obligations working while implementing the current delta.
The `architecture_notes` string is an archived impact explanation, not an
automatically persisted repository file. Put any notes needed by a later
maintainer in a changed Markdown file in `files`; those bytes are then ordinary
repository state and count in later supplied context. Tests are also ordinary
repository artifacts, not replacements for the external contract. Do not add
tools, network calls, clocks, randomness, graphics, or external services.
Use checked 64-bit arithmetic and deterministic ordinal ordering. Keep effects
and errors observable exactly as specified. Public examples are executable
examples, not implementation prescriptions.
guidance.language_guidance:
# F# language guidance

Use the .NET 10.0.302 SDK and the flat `Simulation.fsproj` project. Keep the
program dependency-free and communicate through JSON Lines on standard input
and output using `System.Text.Json`. F# records, discriminated unions,
immutable maps, and small private functions are natural choices for modelling
state transitions and checked arithmetic. Preserve ordinal ordering and the
public wire contract exactly; do not add libraries, services, or runtime
configuration.

past_public_obligations:
# Episode 01 — deferred commands

Add `enqueue` (`at`,`sequence`,`command`) where `at` is strictly greater than
the current tick and at most 1,000,000, `sequence` is non-negative signed 64-bit,
and command is a fully shaped/domain-valid `spawn` or `remove`. Shape, ID,
range, and command-field errors occur at enqueue; duplicate IDs and missing
entities are checked only when due. A successful enqueue emits
`enqueue:<at>:<sequence>`.

Each outer tick increments the clock one at a time. It extracts the whole due
batch, sorted by `(at, sequence, enqueue-order)`, executes commands, then moves
all entities, then proceeds to the next tick. Inner errors append normal errors,
are atomic for that inner command, and do not abort the batch. The outer
`tick:<count>` effect is last. Overflow anywhere in the entire outer operation
rolls back state, queue, effects, and inner errors, emitting only `overflow`.
Saved state carries pending commands internally; seed response snapshots stay
unchanged. Preserve seed behavior. Enqueue order is a monotonically increasing
ordinal among commands admitted into the current world; save/load restores its
ordering effect. Use ordinal order only to resolve equal at/sequence entries.
If the next required ordinal exceeds signed 64-bit, enqueue fails atomically
with `overflow`. Empty pending work may restart the ordinal at zero; drained
history is not observable.
Malformed nested commands use the seed operation errors, including
`unknown_operation`; valid but unsupported nested operations yield
`invalid_value`. Never consult current entity existence during enqueue.
An operation is recognized only after its public introduction. For a recognized
but unsupported nested operation, check its immediate required/extra fields and
their JSON types first (`invalid_shape` on failure), then return `invalid_value`.
Do not execute it, inspect its nested payload's semantics or resolve world-state
references. The full shape/domain validation above applies to the supported
`spawn` and `remove` commands. Unknown names remain `unknown_operation`.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"enqueue","at":2,"sequence":9,"command":{"op":"spawn","id":"z","x":0,"velocity":0}},{"op":"enqueue","at":1,"sequence":4,"command":{"op":"spawn","id":"b","x":0,"velocity":0}},{"op":"enqueue","at":1,"sequence":2,"command":{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":0,"velocity":0}},{"op":"tick","count":2}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":2,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":0,"velocity":0},{"id":"b","x":0,"velocity":0},{"id":"z","x":0,"velocity":0}]},"effects":["enqueue:2:9","enqueue:1:4","enqueue:1:2","spawn:a","spawn:b","spawn:z","tick:2"],"errors":[],"snapshots":[]}`
# Episode 02 — removal during a tick

Removal clears only future queued `remove` commands for that ID. A command
already extracted into the current tick batch still runs: a later same-batch
remove therefore yields `missing_entity`; a canceled future remove yields no
effect or error. A deferred spawn is never canceled and may reuse an ID.
Removal must never erase past emitted effects. Do not introduce a queued effect
store. Preserve all seed and Episode 01 behavior cumulatively; missing
prior behavior is a prerequisite failure, not an exemption.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":0,"velocity":0},{"op":"enqueue","at":1,"sequence":1,"command":{"op":"remove","id":"a"}},{"op":"enqueue","at":1,"sequence":2,"command":{"op":"remove","id":"a"}},{"op":"tick","count":1}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":1,"entities":[]},"effects":["spawn:a","enqueue:1:1","enqueue:1:2","remove:a","tick:1"],"errors":["missing_entity"],"snapshots":[]}`
# Episode 03 — follower interaction

Add `spawn_follower` (`id`,`target`,`x`). Duplicate-ID validation precedes
target lookup; a missing target is `missing_entity`. A follower has wire fields
`kind:"follower"`, `id`, `x`, `velocity:0`, and `target:string|null`; movers
retain seed shape. On every tick movers advance first. Followers then update
simultaneously from the post-mover/pre-follower snapshot by the sign of
`target.x - self.x` (one unit toward target; equal means no move). Chains are
therefore deterministic. Removing a target sets followers' target to null and
reuse never silently reattaches. Save/load preserves kinds and targets.

`x` uses the spawn coordinate bounds; `id` and `target` use the seed ID grammar.
Shape/value checks precede duplicate and missing-target checks. Success emits
`spawn:<id>`. A null target stays still. Compare positions to determine direction
without overflowing a subtraction at signed-64-bit extremes. Adding or
subtracting the one-unit step remains checked. Same-tick deferred spawns/removes
run before both movement phases. Deferred commands remain only spawn/remove.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":0,"velocity":1},{"op":"spawn_follower","id":"b","target":"a","x":3},{"op":"tick","count":1}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":1,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":1,"velocity":1},{"kind":"follower","id":"b","x":2,"velocity":0,"target":"a"}]},"effects":["spawn:a","spawn:b","tick:1"],"errors":[],"snapshots":[]}`
# Episode 04 — snapshot v2 and v1 migration

Add `import_snapshot` (`name`,`data`). Legacy v1 data is `{tick,entities}` with
movers only and an empty queue. v2 is `{version:2,tick,entities,pending}`;
entities explicitly contain mover/follower kind and precise fields, and
pending entries are `{at,sequence,order,command}`. All arrays are canonically
sorted; `order` is unique. Validate all shape, ranges, past-at values,
duplicates, and references before storing, atomically. Invalid version yields
`snapshot_version`; other invalid data uses existing shape/value/entity errors.

Import succeeds with `import:<name>`, stores only the named snapshot, and does
not change the live world. `load` remains named. From this episode onward
response snapshots supersede the old shape with `{"name":name,"data":<v2>}`.
Preserve all
prior behavior and checked arithmetic.

The exact v2 entity alternatives are
`{kind:"mover",id,x,velocity}` and
`{kind:"follower",id,x,velocity:0,target:<id-or-null>}`.
Legacy entities have exactly the seed entity keys. Tick is non-negative signed
64-bit; imported x/velocity are signed 64-bit (not the narrower spawn-input
bounds). Followers must have velocity zero and targets must name an imported
entity or be null; a self-target is invalid. Missing targets are `missing_entity`.
Unknown entity kinds, duplicate entity IDs, invalid ordering values or self
references are `invalid_value`. Shapes/values are checked before relationships.
No movement occurs on import.

v2 `pending` is required. Each entry has the four specified fields: at must be
greater than the imported tick and at most 1,000,000; sequence/order are
non-negative signed 64-bit; order values must be unique. Validate commands as
at enqueue, without checking current entity existence. Canonical output pending
order is (at, sequence, order); entity order is ordinal id. Input array order
need not be canonical. From this episode, every new enqueue uses one plus the
greatest currently pending order, or zero when the pending queue is empty. This
fixes the exposed ordinal representation without preserving drained history.
If that greatest order is Int64.MaxValue, the enqueue fails atomically with
`overflow`. Importing or loading an otherwise valid queue with that order does
not itself overflow; it does not need to compute a new admission ordinal.

Legacy data has exactly tick/entities and implies empty pending work; explicit
unsupported version values produce `snapshot_version`. Import overwrites the
named snapshot. Save/load continues to deep-copy all current-world state, not
the named snapshot registry or accumulated effect/error logs. Previously created
snapshots are rendered in the current response schema, including legacy imports.
The request protocol and response top-level version remain 1.

`data` must be an object. When a version field is present it must be the JSON
integer literal 2; any other value/type is `snapshot_version`. Otherwise the
legacy shape applies. Extra/missing keys or wrong field types use
`invalid_shape`; numeric-literal, range and ID-domain violations use
`invalid_value`, as in the seed contract. Newly declared optional v2 fields
from later public requirements are the only additions to these exact shapes.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"import_snapshot","name":"old","data":{"tick":3,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":5,"velocity":2}]}},{"op":"load","name":"old"}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":3,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":5,"velocity":2}]},"effects":["import:old","load:old"],"errors":[],"snapshots":[{"name":"old","data":{"version":2,"tick":3,"entities":[{"kind":"mover","id":"a","x":5,"velocity":2}],"pending":[]}}]}`
# Episode 05 — policy extension boundary

Provide a semantic extension boundary for policies applied during normal
entity movement; its internal names and representation are idiomatic choices,
not a required private method. `register_policy` (`name`,`kind`) accepts the
deterministic `clamp10` kind, which applies `min(normalNextX,10)`. Names must be
unique; duplicate names or unknown kinds yield `invalid_value` atomically and
success emits `register:<name>`. `assign_policy` (`id`,`name`) checks missing
entity before unknown name, then emits `policy:<id>:<name>`. Only assigned live
entities carry policy. Snapshot v2 adds sorted policy `{name,kind}` registry
and optional entity policy; absent fields default empty. Save/load restores
registry and assignments. Preserve all earlier obligations.

The new v2 top-level key is `policies`, an array of exactly `{name,kind}` entries
sorted by ordinal name, with unique ID-shaped names and kind `clamp10` only.
It defaults to [] when importing an earlier v2 snapshot. An assigned entity has
one extra `policy` string field in live and snapshot output; absent means normal
movement. An imported assignment must refer to an imported policy, otherwise
`invalid_value`; names must be unique. An unassigned entity has no policy key.
Registering or assigning does not move an entity. During a tick compute checked
normal next x, then clamp; followers see post-policy mover positions, and their
own policy applies after calculating their simultaneous follower step.
Removal drops that entity's assignment but not the policy registry. All other
snapshot keys are unchanged until explicitly extended by a later requirement.

## Public example

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":9,"velocity":3},{"op":"register_policy","name":"cap","kind":"clamp10"},{"op":"assign_policy","id":"a","name":"cap"},{"op":"tick","count":1}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":1,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":10,"velocity":3,"policy":"cap"}]},"effects":["spawn:a","register:cap","policy:a:cap","tick:1"],"errors":[],"snapshots":[]}`
seed_contract:
# Maintenance simulation: seed contract v1

This is the complete public, language-neutral JSON-lines contract for a small
headless deterministic kernel. A request is one UTF-8 JSON object on one line;
one response is one JSON object on one line. Requests start independent state.
No network, clock, randomness, graphics, floating point, or external package
is permitted.

## Wire shape and domain

The request is `{"version":1,"operations":[...]}` and `version` is exactly 1.
Each operation is an object with an `op` string and only its specified fields.
Integers are signed 64-bit. Spawn `x` and `velocity` are each in
`[-1000000,1000000]`; tick `count` is 1..1000; operations has at most 256
items. IDs and snapshot names are ordinal strings matching
`[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`. IDs are strings, not numbers. Arithmetic overflow is
an error and never wraps.

Allowed operations are `spawn` (`id`,`x`,`velocity`), `remove` (`id`), `tick`
(`count`), `save` (`name`), and `load` (`name`). Spawn creates a mover and
tick applies its velocity once per internal tick. Remove requires an existing
mover. Save overwrites an existing name with a deep snapshot. Load replaces
the live tick/entities with that snapshot; it does not erase prior effects,
errors, or snapshots.

The top-level keys must be exactly `version` and `operations`; malformed JSON,
a non-object request, wrong top-level fields/types/version or more than 256
operations produces a fresh empty response with one `invalid_shape` error.
An empty operations array is valid. Each nonblank input line gets one response;
blank lines are ignored. Duplicate JSON keys are outside the input domain.

Within a valid request, validate each operation separately. A missing/non-string
`op`, non-object operation, missing/wrong field types or extra operation fields
is an atomic `invalid_shape` operation error, NOT a reset of the whole request.
An unrecognized string `op` is `unknown_operation` before other field checks.
JSON booleans are not numbers. Numeric fields must be JSON integer literals
(no decimal point or exponent); non-integer or out-of-range numeric values and
ID-regex violations produce `invalid_value`. Validate shape, then values, then
state-dependent preconditions. Duplicate spawn IDs produce `duplicate_id`.
Removing an absent ID produces `missing_entity`; loading an absent name produces
`missing_snapshot`. Other
errors are `duplicate_id`, `missing_entity`, `missing_snapshot`, `overflow`,
and `snapshot_version`. Semantic errors are atomic per operation: state, tick,
snapshots, effects, and errors before that operation are unchanged. Processing
continues with later operations. A malformed whole request has only its one
`invalid_shape` error.

The response is
`{"version":1,"state":{"tick":n,"entities":[...]},"effects":[string,...],"errors":[string,...],"snapshots":[{"name":string,"tick":n,"entities":[...]}]}`.
Entities and snapshots are sorted by ordinal ID/name. An entity is
`{"id":string,"x":integer,"velocity":integer}`. Effects preserve occurrence
order and are `spawn:<id>`, `remove:<id>`, `tick:<count>`, `save:<name>`, or
`load:<name>`. A successful tick emits one effect for the operation, not one
per internal step. A failed operation emits no effect. Checked signed-64-bit
addition is required at every internal tick, including the tick counter. Output
positions may exceed the spawn input bounds but must remain signed 64-bit.
The initial state is tick zero, no entities and no saved snapshots. Semantic
error rollback preserves all earlier operation effects/errors, then appends the
current error code exactly once. Tick overflow rolls back the whole count.

## Public examples

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"spawn","id":"a","x":2,"velocity":3},{"op":"tick","count":2},{"op":"save","name":"s"},{"op":"remove","id":"a"},{"op":"load","name":"s"}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":2,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":8,"velocity":3}]},"effects":["spawn:a","tick:2","save:s","remove:a","load:s"],"errors":[],"snapshots":[{"name":"s","tick":2,"entities":[{"id":"a","x":8,"velocity":3}]}]}`

Input: `{"version":1,"operations":[{"op":"remove","id":"z"},{"op":"tick","count":0},{"op":"spawn","id":"b","x":0,"velocity":1},{"op":"spawn","id":"b","x":4,"velocity":1}]}`

Output: `{"version":1,"state":{"tick":0,"entities":[{"id":"b","x":0,"velocity":1}]},"effects":["spawn:b"],"errors":["missing_entity","invalid_value","duplicate_id"],"snapshots":[]}`

source.Simulation.fs:
module Simulation

open System
open System.IO
open System.Text.Json
open System.Text.RegularExpressions
open System.Collections.Generic

type Entity = { Id: string; X: int64; Velocity: int64; Kind: string; Target: string option; Policy: string option }
type Command = SpawnCommand of string * int64 * int64 | RemoveCommand of string
type Pending = { At:int64; Sequence:int64; Order:int64; Command:Command }
type Snapshot = { Tick: int64; Entities: Map<string, Entity>; Pending: Pending list; Policies: Map<string,string> }
type World = { Tick: int64; Entities: Map<string, Entity>; Snapshots: Map<string, Snapshot>; Pending: Pending list; NextOrder:int64; Policies: Map<string,string>; Effects: string list; Errors: string list }

let empty = { Tick = 0L; Entities = Map.empty; Snapshots = Map.empty; Pending=[]; NextOrder=0L; Policies=Map.empty; Effects = []; Errors = [] }
let idPattern = Regex("\A[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}\z", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)

let private props (e: JsonElement) = e.EnumerateObject() |> Seq.map (fun p -> p.Name) |> Set.ofSeq
let private exact (expected: string list) (e: JsonElement) =
    let names = props e
    names.Count = expected.Length && expected |> List.forall names.Contains
let private stringField (name: string) (e: JsonElement) =
    match e.TryGetProperty(name) with | true, v when v.ValueKind = JsonValueKind.String -> Some (v.GetString()) | _ -> None
let private integerField (name: string) (e: JsonElement) =
    match e.TryGetProperty(name) with
    | true, v when v.ValueKind = JsonValueKind.Number && Regex.IsMatch(v.GetRawText(), "^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$") ->
        let raw = v.GetRawText()
        match Int64.TryParse(raw, Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign, Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) with | true, n -> Some n | _ -> None
    | _ -> None
let private validId (s: string) = idPattern.IsMatch(s)
let private inRange n = n >= -1000000L && n <= 1000000L
let private fieldHasKind (name: string) (kind: JsonValueKind) (e: JsonElement) =
    match e.TryGetProperty(name) with | true, value -> value.ValueKind = kind | _ -> false
let private fieldsHaveKinds (fields: (string * JsonValueKind) list) (e: JsonElement) =
    fields |> List.forall (fun (name, kind) -> fieldHasKind name kind e)
let private sortedEntities (m: Map<string, Entity>) = m |> Map.toList |> List.sortWith (fun (a,_) (b,_) -> StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a,b)) |> List.map snd
let private sortedSnapshots (m: Map<string, Snapshot>) = m |> Map.toList |> List.sortWith (fun (a,_) (b,_) -> StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a,b))
let private sortedPending p = p |> List.sortWith (fun a b -> let c=compare a.At b.At in if c<>0 then c else let c2=compare a.Sequence b.Sequence in if c2<>0 then c2 else compare a.Order b.Order)
let private parseEntity (e:JsonElement) =
    if e.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object then Error "invalid_shape" else
    let target = match e.TryGetProperty("target") with | true,v when v.ValueKind=JsonValueKind.Null -> Some None | true,v when v.ValueKind=JsonValueKind.String -> Some(Some(v.GetString())) | false,_ -> Some None | _ -> None
    let policy = stringField "policy" e
    let moverShape = exact ["kind";"id";"x";"velocity"] e || exact ["kind";"id";"x";"velocity";"policy"] e
    let followerShape = exact ["kind";"id";"x";"velocity";"target"] e || exact ["kind";"id";"x";"velocity";"target";"policy"] e
    let shapeValid = match stringField "kind" e with | Some "mover" -> moverShape | Some "follower" -> followerShape | Some _ -> moverShape || followerShape | None -> exact ["id";"x";"velocity"] e
    if not shapeValid then Error "invalid_shape" else
    let optionalKindValid (name:string) (kind:JsonValueKind) = match e.TryGetProperty(name) with | false,_ -> true | true,value -> value.ValueKind=kind
    let targetKindValid = match e.TryGetProperty("target") with | false,_ -> true | true,value -> value.ValueKind=JsonValueKind.String || value.ValueKind=JsonValueKind.Null
    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["id",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number;"velocity",JsonValueKind.Number] e && optionalKindValid "kind" JsonValueKind.String && optionalKindValid "policy" JsonValueKind.String && targetKindValid) then Error "invalid_shape" else
    match stringField "kind" e, stringField "id" e, target, integerField "x" e, integerField "velocity" e with
    | Some "mover",Some id,Some None,Some x,Some v when validId id -> Ok {Id=id;X=x;Velocity=v;Kind="mover";Target=None;Policy=policy}
    | Some "follower",Some id,Some parsedTarget,Some x,Some 0L when validId id && Option.forall validId parsedTarget -> Ok {Id=id;X=x;Velocity=0L;Kind="follower";Target=parsedTarget;Policy=policy}
    | None,Some id,Some None,Some x,Some v when exact ["id";"x";"velocity"] e && validId id -> Ok {Id=id;X=x;Velocity=v;Kind="mover";Target=None;Policy=None}
    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
let private parseImported (_name:string) (data:JsonElement) =
    if data.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object then Error "invalid_shape"
    else
      let hasVersion,_ = data.TryGetProperty("version")
      let expected = if hasVersion then ["version";"tick";"entities";"pending"] else ["tick";"entities"]
      if hasVersion && not (exact expected data || exact (expected @ ["policies"]) data) then Error "invalid_shape"
      elif not hasVersion && not (exact expected data) then Error "invalid_shape"
      elif hasVersion && (data.GetProperty("version").ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Number || data.GetProperty("version").GetRawText() <> "2") then Error "snapshot_version"
      else
        let tick = integerField "tick" data
        let entities = data.GetProperty("entities")
        if tick.IsNone || tick.Value < 0L then Error "invalid_value"
        elif entities.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Array || (hasVersion && data.GetProperty("pending").ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Array) then Error "invalid_shape"
        else
          let parsed = entities.EnumerateArray() |> Seq.map(fun entity -> if (entity.ValueKind=JsonValueKind.Object && (entity.TryGetProperty("kind")|>fst))<>hasVersion then Error "invalid_shape" else parseEntity entity) |> Seq.toList
          if parsed |> List.exists Result.isError then parsed |> List.choose (function Error error -> Some error | _ -> None) |> List.head |> Error
          else
            let es = parsed |> List.choose (function Ok e -> Some e | _ -> None)
            if es |> List.map (fun e->e.Id) |> Set.ofList |> Set.count <> es.Length then Error "invalid_value"
            elif es |> List.exists (fun e -> e.Target=Some e.Id) then Error "invalid_value"
            elif es |> List.exists (fun e -> e.Target.IsSome && not (es |> List.exists (fun x->Some x.Id=e.Target))) then Error "missing_entity"
            else
              let parsePending (item: JsonElement) =
                  if item.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object || not (exact ["at";"sequence";"order";"command"] item) || not (fieldHasKind "command" JsonValueKind.Object item) then Error "invalid_shape" else
                  if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["at",JsonValueKind.Number;"sequence",JsonValueKind.Number;"order",JsonValueKind.Number] item) then Error "invalid_shape" else
                  match integerField "at" item, integerField "sequence" item, integerField "order" item with
                  | Some at,Some sequence,Some order when at > tick.Value && at <= 1000000L && sequence >= 0L && order >= 0L ->
                      let command = item.GetProperty("command")
                      match stringField "op" command with
                      | Some "spawn" when exact ["op";"id";"x";"velocity"] command ->
                          if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number;"velocity",JsonValueKind.Number] command) then Error "invalid_shape" else
                          match stringField "id" command,integerField "x" command,integerField "velocity" command with
                          | Some id,Some x,Some velocity when validId id && inRange x && inRange velocity -> Ok {At=at;Sequence=sequence;Order=order;Command=SpawnCommand(id,x,velocity)}
                          | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
                      | Some "remove" when exact ["op";"id"] command ->
                          if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String] command) then Error "invalid_shape" else
                          match stringField "id" command with | Some id when validId id -> Ok {At=at;Sequence=sequence;Order=order;Command=RemoveCommand id} | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
                      | Some "tick" -> if exact ["op";"count"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"count",JsonValueKind.Number] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "save" | Some "load" -> if exact ["op";"name"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "enqueue" -> if exact ["op";"at";"sequence";"command"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"at",JsonValueKind.Number;"sequence",JsonValueKind.Number;"command",JsonValueKind.Object] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "spawn_follower" -> if exact ["op";"id";"target";"x"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"target",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "import_snapshot" -> if exact ["op";"name";"data"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"data",JsonValueKind.Object] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "register_policy" -> if exact ["op";"name";"kind"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"kind",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some "assign_policy" -> if exact ["op";"id";"name"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
                      | Some unknown when unknown<>"spawn" && unknown<>"remove" -> Error "unknown_operation"
                      | Some _ -> Error "invalid_shape"
                      | None -> Error "invalid_shape"
                  | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
              let pendingResults = if hasVersion then data.GetProperty("pending").EnumerateArray() |> Seq.map parsePending |> Seq.toList else []
              let policyResults =
                  if hasVersion && (data.TryGetProperty("policies") |> fst) then
                      let items = data.GetProperty("policies")
                      if items.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Array then [Error "invalid_shape"]
                      else
                          items.EnumerateArray()
                          |> Seq.map (fun policy ->
                              if policy.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object || not (exact ["name";"kind"] policy) || not (fieldsHaveKinds ["name",JsonValueKind.String;"kind",JsonValueKind.String] policy) then Error "invalid_shape"
                              else
                                  match stringField "name" policy, stringField "kind" policy with
                                  | Some name, Some "clamp10" when validId name -> Ok (name,"clamp10")
                                  | _ -> Error "invalid_value")
                          |> Seq.toList
                  else []
              match pendingResults |> List.tryPick (function Error error -> Some error | _ -> None), policyResults |> List.tryPick (function Error error -> Some error | _ -> None) with
              | Some error,_ | _,Some error -> Error error
              | None,None ->
                  let pending = pendingResults |> List.choose (function Ok item -> Some item | _ -> None)
                  let pairs=policyResults |> List.choose(function Ok pair->Some pair | _->None)
                  let policies=Map.ofList pairs
                  if pending |> List.map (fun item -> item.Order) |> Set.ofList |> Set.count <> pending.Length || policies.Count<>pairs.Length || es |> List.exists(fun e->e.Policy |> Option.exists(fun p->not(policies.ContainsKey p))) then Error "invalid_value"
                  else Ok {Tick=tick.Value;Entities=es |> List.map(fun e->e.Id,e) |> Map.ofList;Pending=pending;Policies=policies}

let private addError code w = { w with Errors = w.Errors @ [code] }
let private addEffect effect w = { w with Effects = w.Effects @ [effect] }

let private applyCommand command w =
    match command with
    | SpawnCommand(id,x,v) when w.Entities.ContainsKey id -> Error "duplicate_id"
    | SpawnCommand(id,x,v) -> Ok { w with Entities=w.Entities.Add(id,{Id=id;X=x;Velocity=v;Kind="mover";Target=None;Policy=None}) }
    | RemoveCommand id when not (w.Entities.ContainsKey id) -> Error "missing_entity"
    | RemoveCommand id ->
        let remaining=w.Pending |> List.filter(fun pending -> match pending.Command with | RemoveCommand removed when removed=id && pending.At>w.Tick -> false | _ -> true)
        let entities=w.Entities.Remove id |> Map.map(fun _ entity -> if entity.Target=Some id then {entity with Target=None} else entity)
        Ok {w with Entities=entities;Pending=remaining}
let private commandEffect command =
    match command with
    | SpawnCommand(id,_,_) -> "spawn:" + id
    | RemoveCommand id -> "remove:" + id
let private parseDeferredCommand (command:JsonElement) =
    if command.ValueKind<>JsonValueKind.Object then Error "invalid_shape" else
    match stringField "op" command with
    | None -> Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "spawn" ->
        if not(exact ["op";"id";"x";"velocity"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number;"velocity",JsonValueKind.Number] command) then Error "invalid_shape" else
        match stringField "id" command,integerField "x" command,integerField "velocity" command with | Some id,Some x,Some velocity when validId id && inRange x && inRange velocity -> Ok(SpawnCommand(id,x,velocity)) | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
    | Some "remove" ->
        if not(exact ["op";"id"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String] command) then Error "invalid_shape" else
        match stringField "id" command with | Some id when validId id -> Ok(RemoveCommand id) | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
    | Some "tick" -> if exact ["op";"count"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"count",JsonValueKind.Number] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "save" | Some "load" -> if exact ["op";"name"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "enqueue" -> if exact ["op";"at";"sequence";"command"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"at",JsonValueKind.Number;"sequence",JsonValueKind.Number;"command",JsonValueKind.Object] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "spawn_follower" -> if exact ["op";"id";"target";"x"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"target",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "import_snapshot" -> if exact ["op";"name";"data"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"data",JsonValueKind.Object] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "register_policy" -> if exact ["op";"name";"kind"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"kind",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some "assign_policy" -> if exact ["op";"id";"name"] command && fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String] command then Error "invalid_value" else Error "invalid_shape"
    | Some _ -> Error "unknown_operation"
let private nextPendingOrder pending =
    match pending with
    | [] -> Ok 0L
    | items ->
        let maximum = (items |> List.maxBy (fun item -> item.Order)).Order
        if maximum = Int64.MaxValue then Error "overflow" else Ok (maximum + 1L)

let private tickWorld count w =
    try
        let mutable entities = w.Entities
        let mutable tick = w.Tick
        let mutable pending = w.Pending
        let mutable errors = w.Errors
        let mutable effects = w.Effects
        for _ in 1 .. int count do
            let due, later = pending |> List.partition (fun p -> p.At = tick + 1L)
            let mutable current = { w with Tick=tick; Entities=entities; Pending=later; Effects=effects; Errors=errors }
            for item in sortedPending due do
                match applyCommand item.Command current with
                | Ok next -> current <- addEffect (commandEffect item.Command) next
                | Error code -> current <- addError code current
            entities <- current.Entities
            let applyPolicy e next = match e.Policy with | Some policy when w.Policies.TryFind policy=Some "clamp10" -> min next 10L | _ -> next
            entities <- entities |> Map.map (fun _ e -> if e.Kind = "mover" then {e with X=applyPolicy e (Checked.(+) e.X e.Velocity)} else e)
            let view = entities
            entities <- entities |> Map.map (fun _ e ->
                match e.Kind, e.Target with
                | "follower", Some target when view.ContainsKey target ->
                    let t = view.[target]
                    if t.X > e.X then {e with X=applyPolicy e (Checked.(+) e.X 1L)} elif t.X < e.X then {e with X=applyPolicy e (Checked.(-) e.X 1L)} else {e with X=applyPolicy e e.X}
                | _ -> e)
            tick <- Checked.(+) tick 1L
            pending <- current.Pending
            errors <- current.Errors
            effects <- current.Effects
        Ok { w with Tick = tick; Entities = entities; Pending = pending; Effects = effects; Errors = errors }
    with :? OverflowException -> Error ()

let private operation (op: JsonElement) (w: World) : Result<World,string> =
    if op.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object || not (op.TryGetProperty("op") |> fst) then Error "invalid_shape"
    else
        match stringField "op" op with
        | None -> Error "invalid_shape"
        | Some name ->
            let shape expected = if exact expected op then Ok () else Error "invalid_shape"
            match name with
            | "spawn" ->
                match shape ["op";"id";"x";"velocity"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String; "id",JsonValueKind.String; "x",JsonValueKind.Number; "velocity",JsonValueKind.Number] op) then Error "invalid_shape"
                    else
                        match stringField "id" op, integerField "x" op, integerField "velocity" op with
                        | Some id, Some x, Some velocity when validId id && inRange x && inRange velocity ->
                            if w.Entities.ContainsKey id then Error "duplicate_id"
                            else Ok (addEffect ("spawn:" + id) { w with Entities = w.Entities.Add(id,{Id=id;X=x;Velocity=velocity;Kind="mover";Target=None;Policy=None}) })
                        | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "enqueue" ->
                match shape ["op";"at";"sequence";"command"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    match integerField "at" op, integerField "sequence" op, op.TryGetProperty("command") with
                    | Some at, Some sequence, (true, command) when at > w.Tick && at <= 1000000L && sequence >= 0L && command.ValueKind = JsonValueKind.Object ->
                        match parseDeferredCommand command with
                        | Error error -> Error error
                        | Ok parsed ->
                            match nextPendingOrder w.Pending with
                            | Error error -> Error error
                            | Ok order -> Ok(addEffect (sprintf "enqueue:%d:%d" at sequence) {w with Pending={At=at;Sequence=sequence;Order=order;Command=parsed}::w.Pending;NextOrder=order})
                    | Some _, Some _, (true, command) when command.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object -> Error "invalid_shape"
                    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "spawn_follower" ->
                match shape ["op";"id";"target";"x"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () when not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"target",JsonValueKind.String;"x",JsonValueKind.Number] op) -> Error "invalid_shape"
                | Ok () ->
                    match stringField "id" op, stringField "target" op, integerField "x" op with
                    | Some id,Some target,Some x when validId id && validId target && inRange x ->
                        if w.Entities.ContainsKey id then Error "duplicate_id" elif not (w.Entities.ContainsKey target) then Error "missing_entity"
                        else Ok (addEffect ("spawn:"+id) {w with Entities=w.Entities.Add(id,{Id=id;X=x;Velocity=0L;Kind="follower";Target=Some target;Policy=None})})
                    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "remove" ->
                match shape ["op";"id"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String; "id",JsonValueKind.String] op) then Error "invalid_shape"
                    else
                        match stringField "id" op with
                        | Some id when validId id ->
                            if w.Entities.ContainsKey id then
                                let remaining = w.Pending |> List.filter (fun p -> match p.Command with | RemoveCommand rid when rid = id && p.At > w.Tick -> false | _ -> true)
                                let detached = w.Entities.Remove id |> Map.map (fun _ e -> if e.Target = Some id then {e with Target=None} else e)
                                Ok (addEffect ("remove:"+id) {w with Entities=detached; Pending=remaining})
                            else Error "missing_entity"
                        | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "tick" ->
                match shape ["op";"count"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String; "count",JsonValueKind.Number] op) then Error "invalid_shape"
                    else
                        match integerField "count" op with
                        | Some n when n >= 1L && n <= 1000L ->
                            match tickWorld n w with
                            | Ok next -> Ok (addEffect ("tick:"+string n) next)
                            | Error () -> Error "overflow"
                        | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "save" ->
                match shape ["op";"name"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String; "name",JsonValueKind.String] op) then Error "invalid_shape"
                    else
                        match stringField "name" op with
                        | Some n when validId n ->
                            let snapshot = { Tick = w.Tick; Entities = w.Entities; Pending = w.Pending; Policies = w.Policies }
                            Ok (addEffect ("save:"+n) { w with Snapshots = w.Snapshots.Add(n, snapshot) })
                        | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "import_snapshot" ->
                match shape ["op";"name";"data"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () when not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"data",JsonValueKind.Object] op) -> Error "invalid_shape"
                | Ok () ->
                    match stringField "name" op with
                    | Some name when validId name ->
                        match parseImported name (op.GetProperty("data")) with
                        | Ok snapshot -> Ok (addEffect ("import:"+name) {w with Snapshots=w.Snapshots.Add(name,snapshot)})
                        | Error code -> Error code
                    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "register_policy" ->
                match shape ["op";"name";"kind"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () when not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String;"kind",JsonValueKind.String] op) -> Error "invalid_shape"
                | Ok () ->
                    match stringField "name" op,stringField "kind" op with
                    | Some name,Some "clamp10" when validId name && not (w.Policies.ContainsKey name) -> Ok (addEffect ("register:"+name) {w with Policies=w.Policies.Add(name,"clamp10")})
                    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "assign_policy" ->
                match shape ["op";"id";"name"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () when not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String;"id",JsonValueKind.String;"name",JsonValueKind.String] op) -> Error "invalid_shape"
                | Ok () ->
                    match stringField "id" op,stringField "name" op with
                    | Some id,Some name when validId id && not (w.Entities.ContainsKey id) -> Error "missing_entity"
                    | Some id,Some name when validId id && w.Policies.ContainsKey name -> Ok (addEffect ("policy:"+id+":"+name) {w with Entities=w.Entities.Add(id,{w.Entities.[id] with Policy=Some name})})
                    | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | "load" ->
                match shape ["op";"name"] with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    if not (fieldsHaveKinds ["op",JsonValueKind.String; "name",JsonValueKind.String] op) then Error "invalid_shape"
                    else
                        match stringField "name" op with
                        | Some n when validId n ->
                            match w.Snapshots.TryFind n with
                            | Some s ->
                                Ok (addEffect ("load:"+n) { w with Tick = s.Tick; Entities = s.Entities; Pending = s.Pending; NextOrder = 0L; Policies = s.Policies })
                            | None -> Error "missing_snapshot"
                        | _ -> Error "invalid_value"
            | _ -> Error "unknown_operation"

let private writeEntity (j: Utf8JsonWriter) e =
    j.WriteStartObject()
    if e.Kind = "follower" then j.WriteString("kind", "follower")
    j.WriteString("id", e.Id)
    j.WriteNumber("x", e.X)
    j.WriteNumber("velocity", e.Velocity)
    if e.Kind = "follower" then
        match e.Target with
        | Some target -> j.WriteString("target", target)
        | None -> j.WriteNull("target")
    match e.Policy with
    | Some policy -> j.WriteString("policy", policy)
    | None -> ()
    j.WriteEndObject()
let private writeSnapshotEntity (j:Utf8JsonWriter) e =
    j.WriteStartObject()
    j.WriteString("kind",e.Kind)
    j.WriteString("id",e.Id)
    j.WriteNumber("x",e.X)
    j.WriteNumber("velocity",e.Velocity)
    if e.Kind="follower" then match e.Target with | Some target -> j.WriteString("target",target) | None -> j.WriteNull("target")
    match e.Policy with | Some policy -> j.WriteString("policy",policy) | None -> ()
    j.WriteEndObject()
let private writePending (j:Utf8JsonWriter) p =
    j.WriteStartObject(); j.WriteNumber("at",p.At); j.WriteNumber("sequence",p.Sequence); j.WriteNumber("order",p.Order); j.WriteStartObject("command")
    match p.Command with | SpawnCommand(id,x,v) -> j.WriteString("op","spawn"); j.WriteString("id",id); j.WriteNumber("x",x); j.WriteNumber("velocity",v) | RemoveCommand id -> j.WriteString("op","remove"); j.WriteString("id",id)
    j.WriteEndObject(); j.WriteEndObject()
let private response (w: World) =
    use stream = new MemoryStream()
    use j = new Utf8JsonWriter(stream)
    j.WriteStartObject(); j.WriteNumber("version",1); j.WriteStartObject("state"); j.WriteNumber("tick",w.Tick); j.WriteStartArray("entities"); sortedEntities w.Entities |> List.iter (writeEntity j); j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteEndObject()
    j.WriteStartArray("effects"); w.Effects |> List.iter j.WriteStringValue; j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteStartArray("errors"); w.Errors |> List.iter j.WriteStringValue; j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteStartArray("snapshots")
    sortedSnapshots w.Snapshots |> List.iter (fun (name,s) -> j.WriteStartObject(); j.WriteString("name",name); j.WriteStartObject("data"); j.WriteNumber("version",2); j.WriteNumber("tick",s.Tick); j.WriteStartArray("entities"); sortedEntities s.Entities |> List.iter (writeSnapshotEntity j); j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteStartArray("pending"); sortedPending s.Pending |> List.iter (writePending j); j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteStartArray("policies"); s.Policies |> Map.toList |> List.sortWith (fun (a,_) (b,_) -> StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a,b)) |> List.iter (fun (policy,kind) -> j.WriteStartObject(); j.WriteString("name",policy); j.WriteString("kind",kind); j.WriteEndObject()); j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteEndObject(); j.WriteEndObject())
    j.WriteEndArray(); j.WriteEndObject(); j.Flush(); Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(stream.ToArray())

let private handle (line: string) =
    try
        use doc = JsonDocument.Parse(line)
        let root = doc.RootElement
        if root.ValueKind <> JsonValueKind.Object || not (exact ["version";"operations"] root) then
            response (addError "invalid_shape" empty)
        else
            let version = root.GetProperty("version")
            let ops = root.GetProperty("operations")
            if version.ValueKind = JsonValueKind.Number && Regex.IsMatch(version.GetRawText(), "^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$") && version.GetInt64() = 1L && ops.ValueKind = JsonValueKind.Array && Seq.length (ops.EnumerateArray()) <= 256 then
                let mutable world = empty
                for op in ops.EnumerateArray() do
                    match operation op world with | Ok next -> world <- next | Error code -> world <- addError code world
                response world
            else
                response (addError "invalid_shape" empty)
    with _ -> response (addError "invalid_shape" empty)

[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ =
    let mutable line = Console.ReadLine()
    while not (isNull line) do
        if not (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace line) then Console.WriteLine(handle (line.TrimStart([| '\uFEFF' |])))
        line <- Console.ReadLine()
    0
